description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Weapon Proficiency
description.value: You have proficiency with Advanced weapons, and your training allows you to use the mastery properties of those weapons.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Weapon Proficiency
description.value: You have proficiency with Advanced weapons, and your training allows you to use the mastery properties of those weapons.

name: Blackpowder Pistol Expert
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity, Constitution or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You have become practiced with the use of Blackpowder Pistols. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Deadeye
description.value: Attacking at long range doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with a Blackpowder Pistol.

description.name: Quick Load
description.value: You ignore Loading of the Blackpowder Pistol.

description.name: Trick Shot
description.value: Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you moves, you can take a Reaction to make a ranged attack with a Blackpowder Pistol against that creature.
Your expertise with twinblades allows you to turn your defensive flourish into an offensive strike. When you use the Whirl special bonus action with a twinblade, you gain the following features:

entries: You can make one additional melee attack with the weapon. This attack uses the same ability modifier as the primary attack, and the weapon's damage die for this attack is a d4.
Until the start of your next turn, other creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they enter your reach or make a melee attack against you while within your reach.

description.value: Your senses are heightened beyond those of most folk. Whether these senses were strengthened through training or the loss of other senses, or they simply matured as you did, you are a master of finding those whom you seek. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Motion Sensor
description.value: Whenever a creature that is Small or larger moves within 10 feet of you while you do not have the Unconscious condition, you immediately become aware of its presence.

description.name: No Hiding
description.value: You have Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sound or smell.

name: Boon of Magic Resistance
abilityIncrease: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Heroic Resistance
description.value: If you fail a saving throw, you can cause yourself to succeed instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

name: Boon of Perfect Flight
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Flying
description.value: You have a Fly Speed of 40 feet and can hover.

description.name: Graceful Fall
description.value: If you fall more than 5 feet, your rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until you land.

name: Boon of Shadowsteel Mastery
prerequisite: Level 19+ and {@charoption Shadowsteel Ghoul|GrimHollowPG24|Shadowsteel Ghoul Transformation}
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Strange Bedfellows
description.value: You are no longer affected by the Friendless.

name: Boon of the Archlich
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Vessel of Vitality
description.value: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, if your Soul Vessel is not charged, it gains a soul and becomes charged.

name: Boon of the Ascended Vampire
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Inured to Sunlight
description.value: You are no longer affected by sunlight.

name: Boon of the Earthly Tether
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Persistent Haunter
description.value: You are no longer affected by the Fraying Reality.

description.name: Divergent Growth
description.value: Choose any Specter Transformation Boon that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Elder Fey
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Fey Bulwark
description.value: You are no longer affected by the Weakened Constitution.

description.name: Divergent Growth
description.value: Choose any Fey Transformation Boon that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Elder Fiend
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.name: Free Agent
description.value: You are no longer affected by the Pull of the Netherworld.

description.name: Divergent Growth
description.value: Choose any Fiend Transformation Boon that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Elder Horror
prerequisite: Level 19+ and {@charoption Aberrant Horror|GrimHollowPG24|Aberrant Horror Transformation}
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Stabilizing Form
description.value: When you roll a 25 or lower on the [Unstable Form table](https://5e.tools/tables.html#unstable%20form_grimhollowpg24), you can choose to roll again. You must use the new result. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Divergent Growth
description.value: Choose any Aberrant Horror Transformation Boon that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Elemental Temperance
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Controlled Chaos
description.value: You are no longer affected by the Primordial Chaos.

name: Boon of the High Seraph
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Absolution
description.value: You are no longer affected by the Seraph Corruption.

description.name: Divergent Growth
description.value: Choose any Seraph Transformation Boon that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Wilds
abilityIncrease: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Apex Predator
description.value: When you enter your Hybrid Form, you gain 25 Temporary Hit Points. At the end of each of your turns while in Hybrid Form, if you have no Temporary Hit Points, you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points. While you are in your Hybrid Form and have no Temporary Hit Points, you have Advantage on attack rolls.

name: Brutal Grip
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Heavy Duelist
description.value: You can wield a Melee weapon with Two-Handed in one hand.

description.name: Versatile Dual Wielder
description.value: While wielding a Melee weapon with Versatile in one hand, the weapon has the Light property for you.
Manipulating your bladed digits with preternatural delicacy, you can switch from exsanguinating slash to soft caress with a deft flick.

entries: After you take the Attack action using a claw in one hand, you can use a bonus action to make up to two melee attacks with a different claw that you're holding in the other hand. You don't add your ability modifier to the damage of the bonus attack(s), unless that modifier is negative, or you have the two-weapon Fighting Style.
You have advantage to hit a target you are grappling with an attack using a claw.
You can equip or unequip either a single or a pair of claws using either a bonus action or action.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Firing in Melee
description.value: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

description.name: Point Blank
description.value: When you hit a creature that is within 5 feet of you with a ranged attack, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.
You know how to spot a liar, and you can get people to see your way, whether through charm, reasonable arguments, or force of will. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Charming Presence
description.value: When you take the Influence action, you don't have Disadvantage on checks to influence Hostile creatures, and you have Advantage on checks to influence Indifferent creatures.

description.name: Multiple Paths
description.value: You can use any ability modifier when you take the Influence action to make an *Intimidation* or *Persuasion* check.

description.name: Zealous Insight
description.value: When you succeed on a Search action's Wisdom (*Insight*) check to detect lies or evasive answers, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls involving combat against that creature for 1 hour.
You have seen death many times, up close and personal, and sometimes at your own hand. These experiences have affected you deeply, teaching you about life and death. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: One Last Breath
description.value: If you have two Death Saving Throw failures, you have Advantage on Death Saving Throws until you are no longer at 0 Hit Points.

description.name: Recuperation
description.value: When you spend a Hit Point Die during a Short Rest to recover Hit Points, you can roll the Hit Point Die twice and use the higher roll.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Dual Shot
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a bow or crossbow, you can make one extra attack as part of the same action against a creature that is within 10 feet of the original target that is within the weapon's range. If you do so, both attacks are made with Disadvantage.

name: Expanded Grip
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: Your natural ability with larger weapons lets you use them in a way others can't. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: One-Handed Grip
description.value: When you use a Versatile weapon with one hand, the weapon deals the damage in parentheses when used to make a melee attack.

description.name: Zealous Grasp
description.value: If an effect forces you to drop what you are holding, you can make a DC 15 Strength saving throw to maintain your grip. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a saving throw to maintain your grip, you have Advantage on the saving throw.

name: Expert Enchanter
abilityIncrease: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You manipulate magical essence with a quick and subtle touch.

entries: When you make an Enchanting check with a skill with which you are proficient, your proficiency bonus is doubled.
When you roll for enchanting quirks, you can apply a bonus or penalty to the result of the roll equal to half your proficiency bonus.
Each hour you spend enchanting an item counts as 2 hours towards the item's completion.

name: Expert Forger
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: An expert with your chosen tools, you can subtly alter an item's final form.

entries: When you make a Manufacturing check with a tool with which you are proficient, your proficiency bonus is doubled.
When you forge an item and roll for enchanting and/or manufacturing quirks, you can apply a bonus or penalty to the result of the roll equal to half your proficiency bonus.
Each hour you spend forging an item counts as 2 hours towards the item's completion.

name: Expert Harvester
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You have a knack for retrieving exceptional components from the gnarliest of corpses.

entries: When you make a Harvesting check using a skill with which you are proficient, your proficiency bonus is doubled.
When you attempt to harvest a creature for which you don't have the required skill proficiency, you can add your proficiency bonus to the result of the roll.
If you are helping with a Harvesting check, you add your full proficiency bonus to the check's result, regardless of whether you're proficient in the requisite skill.
You do not suffer disadvantage on your Harvesting checks as a result of choosing to perform both the Assessment and Carving checks alone.

description.value: Your deadly speed with nunchaku can strike fear into your foes.

entries: When you take the Attack action and attack with a nunchaku, you can use a bonus action to make one additional melee attack with the weapon. This attack uses the same ability modifier as the primary attack and the weapon's damage die for this attack is a d4.

When you take the Flourish special action with a nunchaku, you can use a bonus action to make it especially intimidating towards one creature within your reach. If you don't fail on your Dexterity check to flourish the weapon, your target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you until the start of your next turn. The DC for the saving throw equals 8 + your Dexterity modifier. If you are proficient in the Intimidation skill, you can add your proficiency bonus to the DC.

name: Field Commander
abilityIncrease: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Command
description.value: As an action, you can issue a command to an ally within 60 feet that can hear you. It can immediately take an action as a Reaction. That action can be used to take only the Attack (one attack only), Dash, Dodge, Hide, Influence, Search, Study, or Utilize action.

description.name: Tight Formation
description.value: While you are within 5 feet of two or more allies that don't have the Incapacitated condition, enemies can't have Advantage on attack rolls against you.
Able to whip up a tasty meal from the barest ingredients, your meals fuel the resolve of the most stalwart adventurers.

entries: You gain proficiency with cook's utensils.
You can replace one type of ingredient in a recipe with any other ingredient type.
Before rolling for quirks, you can choose to replace one roll on the boon table with inspiration, granting inspiration to each creature that consumes at least one portion of your meal.
After rolling for quirks, you can remove one flaw of your choice, or add a boon to the dish by rolling on the boons table (your choice).

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Quick Strike
description.value: Once on each of your turns when you make an attack roll with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike and have Advantage on the roll, you can forgo Advantage on that attack roll. After resolving that attack, you can then make another attack with the same weapon or Unarmed Strike against a different creature. The new target must be within 5 feet of the first target and within the weapon's reach.

name: Focused Critical
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Improved Critical
description.value: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

name: Forgemaster
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: Your deftness with your tools of choice is unparalleled.

entries: When you make a Manufacturing check with a tool with which you are proficient, you have advantage on the roll.
You gain proficiency with 2 tools of your choice.
Each hour you spend forging an item counts as 3 hours towards the item's completion.

description.value: Your connection to the Thaumaturge puts you in touch with forces outside mortal understanding, making others think you were born under a fortunate moon. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Fortune's Fortitude
description.value: When you fail a D20 Test, you can expend and roll one Hit Point Die, adding that number to your result. You can do this only once per D20 Test.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses of this ability when you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Fortune of the Unknown
description.value: When using the Fortune's Fortitude benefit, if you roll the highest or lowest number on the Hit Point Die, you regain that Hit Point Die. It still counts as a use of Fortune's Fortitude.
Your training with the Company of Free Swords has given you an increased stamina and an attitude that make you less likely to succumb to hardships. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Hold the Ground
description.value: When you are moved without using your movement by a creature, you can take a Reaction to reduce the distance you are moved by up to your Speed.

description.name: Resolute
description.value: You have Advantage on saving throws that would apply a condition.

name: Hulking Figure
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: Either from extensive training or a natural build, you have a broad and formidable size for your species. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Brutal
description.value: Once per turn, you can deal an extra **1d4** Bludgeoning damage to a target you hit with an Unarmed Strike.

description.name: Intimidating
description.value: When you make a Charisma (*Intimidation*, *Performance*, or *Persuasion*) check, you can also add your Strength modifier to the roll.

description.name: Powerful
description.value: You count as one size larger (to a maximum size of Large) when determining your carrying capacity.

Your expeditions, transactions, and mercantile activities on behalf of the Augustine Trading Company have put you in contact with collectors of historical artifacts, relics, and tomes. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Object Intuition
description.value: You can take a Study action to examine one magical object and learn its properties and how to use it without attuning to it or taking a Short Rest in physical contact with it, but you don't learn any curse the item might bear. There is a cumulative 5% chance for every rarity above Common that you misidentify the nature and the power of the object.

description.name: Rare Find
description.value: You begin play in possession of a Common magic item. Work with your GM to decide on which object fits your character and the campaign.

name: Iron Gut
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength, Constitution or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You can eat like a hill giant and drink like a fish. Years of punishing your stomach and liver have led to a powerful fortitude. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Inured to Poison
description.value: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

description.name: Everything Looks Delicious
description.value: You have Advantage on Wisdom (*Survival*) checks to forage for food.

description.name: Quick to Recover
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one of your Hit Point Dice, roll the die and add your Constitution modifier, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll's total. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

name: Iron Hero
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Underdog's Resolve
description.value: When you are attacked by a creature that has a CR higher than your level, you gain a +2 bonus to your Armor Class for that attack.

description.name: Vengeful Strike
description.value: You have Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that has reduced one of your allies to 0 Hit Points since the end of your last turn.

description.name: Heroic Intervention
description.value: When an enemy you can see takes a Legendary Action, you can take a Reaction to intercede, preventing the Legendary Action from happening. You can take this Reaction a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

name: Jack of All Tools
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You learn to wield tools with precision and efficiency, improvising where necessary.

entries: You gain proficiency with 3 tools of your choice.

When you make a Manufacturing check using a tool with which you are not proficient, you can add half your proficiency bonus instead, and do not suffer any disadvantage due to not having proficiency with the tool.
Each hour you spend manufacturing an item counts as 2 hours towards the item's completion.

name: Lightning Caster
prerequisite: Level 4+ and Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
abilityIncrease: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: Your rapid-fire style of casting cantrips allows you to weave magic with uncanny speed. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Dual Target
description.value: When you cast a cantrip with a casting time of an action that targets a single creature, you can use a Bonus Action to target a second creature within the cantrip's range.

description.name: Immediate Response
description.value: When you cast a spell as a Reaction, that spell doesn't expend a spell slot. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
You are a master of the medical sciences because of your association with a medical institute. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Adept Medic
description.value: When you use the Blood and Bone benefit of the Triage Expert feat, the creature can spend up to three Hit Point Dice instead of one.

description.name: Battle Surgeon
description.value: When you use the Blood and Bone benefit of the Triage Expert feat, the creature can spend three Hit Point Dice to end one of the following conditions on itself instead of regaining Hit Points: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned.
Alternatively, you can cure one Grievous Wound affecting the creature.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Slippery
description.value: When you take the Attack action, your Speed increases by 10 feet and Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you until the end of your turn.

name: Nimble Physique
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You are small and thin for your species. You have a mysterious and consistent ability to avoid danger. You gain the following benefits:

entries: **Dodgy**: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, you can take the Dodge action as a Bonus Action.
**Slippery**: While you are Grappled or Restrained, your attacks don't have Disadvantage and attacks against you don't have Advantage.

description.value: You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Exploit Weakness
description.value: Whenever you make an attack as part of a Reaction, you gain a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls.
You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Defensive
description.value: When you have the Prone condition, you don't have Disadvantage on attack rolls. Attack rolls against you don't have Advantage because of the Prone condition.

description.name: Hop Up
description.value: When you have the Prone condition, you can right yourself with only 5 feet of movement.

name: Reapmaster
abilityIncrease: Increase your Dexterity or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: Few hunters can match your knowledge and skill in obtaining pristine components.

entries: You gain proficiency in one skill from the following options: Arcana, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Religion, or Survival.
When you make a Harvesting check using a skill with which you are proficient, you have advantage on the roll.

description.value: Membership in the Ebon Syndicate provides perks—one of which is the motivation that comes with the understanding that the Syndicate kills those who fail too often. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Quick Strike
description.value: On your first turn after an Initiative roll, add 1d4 to the first damage roll you make. This extra damage increases to 2d4 at character level 9, and to 4d4 at character level 16.

description.name: Resilient
description.value: Your Hit Point maximum increases by an amount equal to your character level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a character level thereafter, your Hit Point maximum increases by an additional 1 Hit Point.

name: Sangromantic Initiate
prerequisite: Level 4+ and Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

description.value: You have become adept enough with weaving blood magic to mitigate some of the harm of Sangromancy. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Blood Magic
description.value: Choose a Sangromancy spell from any spell list of a level for which you have spell slots. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slot you have.

description.name: Sanguine Potency
description.value: You have a pool of two d12s that you can expend instead of Hit Point Dice when you cast Sangromancy spells. Your pool regains all expended dice when you finish a Long Rest.

name: Scourge Master
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: Your skill with whips and tetherhooks allows you to manipulate items at a distance.

entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using a tetherhooks or whip, you can use a bonus action to attempt to disarm the creature of a shield, or of one item it is holding. Make a Strength or Dexterity check (your choice) contested by the target's Strength check. If you succeed, the item is dropped on the ground midway between you and the creature.
You can use your whip or tetherhooks to grab items weighing less than 1 lb within the reach of your weapon, pulling them back to your person.

name: Shadowsteel Adept
prerequisite: Level 4+ and Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
abilityIncrease: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You have learned to tap into the dangerous but powerful art of Shadowsteel casting. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Curse Caster
description.value: You always have Shadowsteel curses prepared, and you can cast them with any spell slots you have.

description.name: Shadowsteel's Bite
description.value: While holding your Shadowsteel Focus, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your spells.

description.name: Shadowsteel Weapon
description.value: If your Shadowsteel Focus is also a weapon, that weapon has a +1 bonus to weapon attack rolls and damage rolls.

name: Shadowsteel Master
abilityIncrease: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: Your mastery over Shadowsteel grows stronger. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Necrotic Harmony
description.value: While holding your Shadowsteel Focus, when you cast a spell that targets one or more creatures and requires an attack roll or saving throw, you can choose one target you hit or who failed the saving throw to also take **1d4** Necrotic damage for each spell slot level expended to cast the spell.

description.name: Necrotic Weapon
description.value: If your Shadowsteel Focus is also a weapon, that weapon has a +2 bonus to weapon attack rolls and damage rolls. Additionally, once on each of your turns, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack roll using your Shadowsteel Focus, you can cause the target to take an extra **2d8** Necrotic damage.

name: Spray 'n' Pray
prerequisite: Proficiency with a magitech firearm or {@item tommybow|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting}

description.value: You've learned to unleash the full potential of mechanised ranged weapons, leaving aiming down to lady luck. You gain the following benefits:

entries: You can reload firearms and tommybows as a bonus action or an action.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
When you use the Attack action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a one-handed firearm or tommybow you are holding.

After you take the Attack action with a tommybow or magitech firearm, you can use a bonus action to quickly make one or two additional ranged weapon attacks using the same weapon. If you choose to make two attacks, you take a -5 penalty to both attack rolls. You don't add your ability modifier to the damage of the bonus attack(s), unless that modifier is negative.

description.value: Your ability to make the best out of a bad situation has served you well. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Hardy
description.value: You need half the amount of food per day based on your size.

description.name: Intuitive
description.value: When you take the Study action, you have Advantage on Intelligence checks made when taking the Study action.

description.name: Shake It Off
description.value: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, your Exhaustion level, if any, decreases by 1. Additionally, when you finish a Long Rest, your Exhaustion level decreases by 2.
Rising in the ranks of the Ebon Syndicate has taught you the clandestine skills of spycraft, valuable in your trade as a racketeer. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Locksmith
description.value: You have proficiency with Thieves' Tools. While holding Thieves' Tools, you can craft a key to a lock by spending 10 minutes with that lock.

description.name: Master of Disguise
description.value: You have proficiency with a Disguise Kit. If you spend 10 minutes donning a Costume, you decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and other distinguishing characteristics. You can make yourself appear as a member of another species, though none of your statistics change. You can't appear as a creature of a different size, and your basic shape stays the same; if you're bipedal, you can't use this benefit to become quadrupedal, for instance.

description.name: Master Calligrapher
description.value: You have proficiency with a Forgery Kit. You aren't limited to 10 or fewer words when mimicking someone else's handwriting.

description.name: Blending In
description.value: When using the Hide action to conceal yourself from creatures that aren't Hostile to you, you need only be Lightly Obscured and you may use Charisma instead of Dexterity for the check.

name: Thrown Weapon Master
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You excel at thrown weapons. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Multithrow
description.value: After you take the Attack action to make a ranged attack roll using a Simple weapon that has Thrown, you can make two additional ranged attacks using Simple weapons that have Thrown as a Bonus Action.

description.name: Quick Hands
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can retrieve and stow or wield all Simple weapons with Thrown that are within 5 feet of you. You need a free hand to perform this maneuver.

description.name: Returning
description.value: Simple weapons with Thrown that you are proficient with also have the __Returning__ mastery property.
You are trained in dealing with injuries on the battlefield, and with the saving of lives afterward. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Bedside Manner
description.value: Whenever you cause a creature to regain Hit Points or the Blood and Bone benefit, you can roll one extra die and discard the lowest die.

description.name: Blood and Bone
description.value: Taking the Utilize action and expending the use of a Healer's Kit lets you heal a creature within 5 feet of you. The creature can expend and roll a Hit Point Die and regain that number of Hit Points.

name: Weavebonder
abilityIncrease: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: With a nuanced touch, you can manipulate even the smallest ebbs and flows of an item's magic.

entries: When you make an Enchanting check with a skill with which you are proficient, you have advantage on the roll.
When you roll for a quirk's random element (such as damage type, skill, or creature type), you can roll the die twice and choose either result.
Each hour you spend enchanting an item counts as 3 hours towards the item's completion.

name: Witch Hunter
abilityIncrease: Increase your Strength, Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

description.value: You have honed and perfected your skills fighting against spellcasters, possibly from your background hunting mages as part of the Arcanist Inquisition. You gain the following benefits.

description.name: Dodge Spells
description.value: You can take a Reaction to avoid a spell that is targeting only you and doesn't create an area of effect. Make a Wisdom saving throw against the spellcaster's spell save DC. On a successful save, the creature must choose a new target or the spell is canceled. A canceled spell dissipates with no effect, and any resources used to cast it are wasted.

description.name: Keep Your Enemies Close
description.value: When you hit a target that can cast spells with an attack roll using a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can reduce its Speed by 15 feet until the start of your next turn.

description.name: Resist Curses
description.value: You have Advantage on saving throws against all Shadowsteel curses, and also against spells with a duration of more than 10 minutes.
